So I'm pretty sure both of these came up during playtesting, but I honestly don't remember the rulings, and even if I dug them up, I'm sure someone who wasn't a playtester would ask eventually.

 

Bestial Shift - based on my understanind of how one-shots work, this should be legitimate, right?

   Begin in Gazelle

   Play Bestial Shift, regain 2 hp, use your base power to turn in Crocodile

   Continue resolving Bestial Shift to deal 3(4) damage, use a power to turn in Rhino

   One-shot action ceases, because you don't go backwards and pick up the Rhino effect.

   Right?

 

Infiltrate and Obfuscate - If there is only 1 villain target, is it both the highest and second highest?  Or is there no second highest, so the effect just fizzles?

I disagree.  It can be highest and lowest simultaneously because it fits both definitions.  There are no villains with higher* hitpoins so this is the highest, there are no villains with lower* hit points so this is the lowest.  You just look at what highest and lowest mean one at a time and see that both fit.  However if we look at second highest, that means that exactly one other villain has higher* hit points.  If there are no other villains this is impossible and fails to be true.

*following rules for ties of course.
